author: Yffe
content: Build forge repair (the background L1/L2 -> L3 upgrade loop): repair.rs (repair_file + bounded REPAIR_LADDER [2,4,8,16] escalation + classify_sub_l3 anti-cheat gate), cli.rs (Command::Repair + run_repair/render_repair), main.rs (mod repair), repair_conformance.rs (live anti-cheat: never_provable_counterexample stays L0 + corpus no-op). Anti-cheat (R-DEFER-9): only a VerusTimeout is escalated; a counterexample/vacuity/weak-contract reject is reported, never retried, never upgraded. Hermetic unit tests pin the upgrade/bounded-termination/determinism/env-error loop logic on synthesized verdicts (OQ-1).
